title: Minimax Rates for Joint Exposure-Cap Means with Face and Corner Contributions
banked_reason: D0.5.G: achieved subfield below field floor; projected paper-score ceiling 7.0 is below the 7.4 field threshold, with no in-scope improvement directive.
gap_reasons: The result remains a specialized two-exposure characterization with fixed finite strata, public regularity constants, and coverage for predetermined threshold pairs.
The causal bridge adds no independent identification novelty, and the rough-face program is unpublished, unverified priority context rather than an archival comparator theorem.
No delivered computation assesses the prescribed interval's conservativeness or demonstrates practical precision planning; the UK Biobank citation supplies motivation without an implementation.
These limits on breadth and demonstrated usefulness constrain the projected paper score to 7.0 despite the completed rate characterization.
proof_attempt_summary: Stage 0 discharged the proposed uniform-radius bottleneck and derived matching four-term risk and honest-interval orders, a causal identification bridge, and an oracle-design comparison. The D0.5 math and decision referees passed and three cited lemmas were source-attested, but the general referee graded the completed package subfield below the required field floor. A broader or empirically demonstrated precision-planning program would be a new proposal, not an in-scope repair of this result.
tldr: The observed joint-cap mean \(\theta_{\delta}\) has four image contributions: an interior, two weighted faces, and a corner. On the maintained measurable tensor-envelope design class and coordinatewise anisotropic H\"older regression class with \(\beta_j\in[1/2,1]\), minimax absolute risk and finite-sample 90\%-honest connected-interval expected length both have the uniform order \(r_n=n^{-1/2}+F_1+F_2+K\). A total matching-and-rectangle estimator and observable bias and combined-coefficient radius attain this order, including random stratum counts, empty donors, and outcomes reused across components. Same-design Bernoulli alternatives prove the same order for every admissible fixed margin even when the entire design is known; learning moving face weights and corner masses therefore costs no minimax order. Boundary suppression and a nonempty corner-dominance region complete the rate description. On the separate explicit full-data class, the supporting identification bridge and onto lift transfer the results to the externally randomized joint-cap causal mean \(\psi_{\delta}\). The 2025 UK Biobank simultaneous-pollutant threshold application motivates the threshold index without establishing membership in either maintained class.
gap: The accepted one-exposure atom frontier and fixed-submanifold inference do not determine uncertainty for the observed-law joint-cap mean on a moving union of unknown weighted faces and a corner under polynomial thinning. The internal rough-face work supplies the regular tangential edge. Stochastic-policy identification is a supporting bridge; the gap is the four-term statistical frontier and its exact honest-length order.
fill: A total matching-and-rectangle estimator, observable bias and combined-coefficient radius, same-class tests, and suppression identities target the uniform four-term observed-law risk and honest-length order. The open content is the uniform radius certificate for the exact sample map. A separate causal identification proposition and onto margin construction transfer those statistical results unchanged to \(\psi_{\delta}\). Pollutant-threshold studies motivate this stochastic-policy question without supplying its identification premises.
